user.title: Floorplan Plus
user.description: Draw each floor over a picture of your floor plan and place your devices on it, to see their live state and your networks where they really are.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Floorplan Plus is already set up.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Returns the full floorplan map, including floors, rooms, walls, and devices.

refresh_zigbee_mesh.name: Refresh Zigbee mesh
refresh_zigbee_mesh.description: Forces a fresh Zigbee2MQTT network scan and caches the result, so the panel's own "Load Mesh" can serve it instantly. Intended for a scheduled/overnight automation, not interactive use (a scan can take 1–2 minutes).
